propositions: Five prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design targeting escape classes: parity siblings, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and known gaps.
Surface-parity census (4a) must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason disposition.
Config-effect contrast (test-design §6) requires one test per config key proving the key changes behavior through the real read path, not merely parsing.

Contention triggers (4b) route by shape to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity-under-contention to sync_contention_harness.
Behavioral gate findings (4g) require RED test first, then fix; non-behavioral findings fixed directly with exemption stated.
